Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.config

Class EnvConfigSource

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.config.EnvConfigSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigSource
public final class EnvConfigSource extends Object implements ConfigSource
A configuration source over environment variables.

A lookup tries the key exactly as given, then in the usual environment form: upper case with every dot replaced by an underscore, so database.default also finds DATABASE_DEFAULT. keys(String) lists variable names as they are written and splits them on dots only; most variable names have none, so it is mainly useful for the empty prefix.

Instances are immutable and safe to share between threads. system() takes a snapshot when it is called.
